secrets.name: The Right Way Round
secrets.text: You come up through the floor into the room the hall was keeping. Everything faces inward here, as it should: the books, the chairs, the lamp. It is very quiet and it is very warm.

meta.label: The Room Inside Out
meta.blurb: Someone has built a room inside out. You are outside it, with the backs of its bookcases, and the door is only painted on.
